last_completed_unit.target: Cargo cargo fetch dependency prefetch and locked/offline constraints
last_completed_unit.result: Official Cargo documentation verifies that with Cargo.lock present cargo fetch downloads git/registry dependencies and makes them locally available so later Cargo commands can run offline unless the lock changes. --locked requires an existing unchanged lock file; --offline forbids network and restricts resolution to locally downloaded crates; --frozen combines locked and offline. This verifies dependency-cache preparation only and does not establish a scheduled-Chat-native Cargo executor.
